summary.text: Katy Hall is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives who has represented District 11 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A registered nurse, she succeeded Kelly Miles in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Katy Hall's career experience includes work as a registered nurse, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office in the Utah House on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Republican convention on April 25, 2026.
